narr: Thunderstorms brought heavy rain, hail, gusty winds, and flash flooding to portions of southern and eastern Utah.
ev: A flash flood due to heavy rain was reported at Blue Pool Wash.
Diamond Fork Road near the Fifth Water Hot Springs trailhead was closed due to mudslides.

There was a photo of water over the roadway and localized flooding near the intersection of 800 N and 1100 E at Meads Wash. The Carbon County Regional Airport/Buck Davis Field ASOS reported 0.44 inches of rain in less than 15 minutes, then 0.59 inches over the following 30 minutes.
Flash flooding was reported in Little Wildhorse Canyon and Bell Canyon. Several camps were impacted by mud and debris washed downstream.
